basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/SOCRadarTAXII/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The [SOCRadar](https://socradar.io/) TAXII 2.1 solution for Microsoft Sentinel imports threat intelligence indicators from SOCRadar TAXII server using an Azure Function App. Supports multiple collections, cursor-based pagination, checkpoint/resume, and batch upload to Microsoft Sentinel TI. **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 1, **Hunting Queries:** 2, **Function Apps:** 1, **Playbooks:** 1 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This solution installs a workbook to visualize SOCRadar TAXII threat intelligence indicators and audit operations.
Visualize SOCRadar TAXII threat intelligence indicators imported into Microsoft Sentinel: indicator counts by type, collection statistics, ingestion trends and the audit log.
This solution installs an analytic rule template that reports when a TAXII import run leaves indicators behind.

elements.name: analytic1
elements.label: SOCRadar TAXII indicators did not reach Microsoft Sentinel

options.text: A TAXII import run did not finish cleanly. Either the run could not reach the TAXII server at all, or it reached it and some indicators never made it into Microsoft Sentinel. The checkpoint does not advance on a failed run, so the next run retries from the same position. What matters is repetition: a collection that keeps reporting this is not recovering on its own, and the feed is standing still. Check the error message on the most recent run, then confirm the credentials and the upload path.
This solution installs hunting queries to analyze SOCRadar TAXII threat intelligence indicators in Microsoft Sentinel.

Overview of threat intelligence indicators ingested via SOCRadar TAXII 2.1 feed.
Groups indicators by type and shows counts per observable key.

Monitors TAXII ingestion health by checking recent import runs.
Identifies failed and partial runs, indicators that did not reach Microsoft Sentinel and creation rates per collection.
Requires SOCRadar-TAXII-Infrastructure playbook deployment.
This solution installs an Azure Function App for TAXII 2.1 ingestion and data collection infrastructure for Microsoft Sentinel.
